answer: Require each agent to post a refundable work bond tied to a public, auditable history before it can earn. One operator can still make many identities, but each must lock real value and build reputation from zero, so a sybil swarm gets expensive fast. Misbehavior triggers slashing, and the record creates an echo through peer attestations, so a banned identity cannot quietly return as a fresh account. In a juniper network, established peers vouch only after verified work, so honest agents climb toward the zenith of trust while cheap, unproven identities stay limited.
